Alger, 4 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L: Algiers, October 4, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Djillali Liabès University of Sidi Bel Abbès and Italy's University of Tuscia have concluded a cooperation agreement. This partnership focuses on training and research in precision and digital agriculture.
Signature d'un accord de coopération tec: Signing of a technological and academic cooperation agreement
L'accord a été paraphé au siège de l'éta: The agreement was initialed at the headquarters of the Italian institution by Amina Khaldi, director of the Institute of Agronomic Sciences at Djillali Liabès University, representing Rector Bouziani Merahi, and Tiziana Laureti, rector of the University of Tuscia. This alliance responds to the technological transformations of the agricultural sector.
Le projet phare de cette entente réside: The flagship project of this agreement lies in the preparation of a joint university curriculum. This program will lead to the issuance of a double degree by both institutions in the specialties of digital and precision agriculture.
En outre, l'accord prévoit d'intensifier: In addition, the agreement provides for intensifying the mobility of students and teacher-researchers. Joint research projects as well as scientific conferences will be organized to encourage the sharing of expertise.
Préparation d'un programme de formation: Preparation of a joint training program leading to a double degree.
Spécialisations ciblées sur l'agricultur: Specializations focused on precision agriculture and digital agriculture.
Renforcement de la mobilité académique p: Strengthening of academic mobility for students and teacher-researchers.
Mise en œuvre de projets de recherche sc: Implementation of joint scientific research projects.
Organisation de colloques et de manifest: Organization of conferences and scientific events between the two institutions.
